description: This file implements a NetworkManager client for a GObject-based environment, providing functions to manage network interfaces such as enabling/disabling interfaces, setting IP configurations, updating route metrics, and retrieving interface details. It interacts with D-Bus proxies to communicate with NetworkManager and configures network settings for Ethernet and Wi-Fi interfaces within a GNOME/GTK environment.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A client class providing methods for managing network interfaces, IP settings, routing, and interface details.

methods.name: bool updateRouteMetric(DbusMgr & m_dbus,const std::string & connectionPath,gint64 route_metric,const gchar * interface,const std::string & activeConnectionPath)
methods.description: Updates the route metric for a given connection and interface in NetworkManager via D-Bus.

methods.name: bool updateIPSettings(DbusMgr & m_dbus,const std::string & connectionPath,const Exchange::INetworkManager::IPAddress & address,const std::string & interface)
methods.description: Updates the IP configuration for a specified interface and applies the changes using NetworkManager.

methods.name: bool updateHostnameSettings(DbusMgr & m_dbus,const std::string & connectionPath,const std::string & hostname,const std::string & interface)
methods.description: Updates the hostname for a network connection associated with a specified interface.

methods.description: Retrieves a list of available network interfaces with their details such as type, MAC address, and connection status.

methods.name: bool setIPSettings(const std::string & interface,const Exchange::INetworkManager::IPAddress & address)
